## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `devtools::test()` passes.
- [ ] A `NEWS.md` bullet for any user-visible change.
- [ ] `devtools::document()` run if roxygen comments changed;
      `devtools::build_readme()` if `README.Rmd` changed.
- [ ] `devtools::check()` passes locally with no errors, warnings or notes.
- [ ] Code formatted with `air format .` (or the pre-commit hooks installed).
- [ ] No change to exported functions, arguments, defaults, options or
      returned data, or the change was agreed in the linked issue.
